portalsFound.observation: Public page exposes a parcel search interface; a machine-readable parcel-list request has not been identified or verified.
Portal describes spatial-data sharing; parcel-list endpoint, access conditions, and scope remain unverified.

Official map displays a Bidang Tanah layer. Its public JavaScript names layer umum:Persil but routes parcel retrieval through /expapi/getPersil with a token from /expapi/loginApi; this is not a verified open parcel feed.
Public map-service metadata has land-ownership polygon layers for 15 provinces, but no DKI Jakarta layer.

requests.observation: Metadata response only; the public land-ownership group omits DKI Jakarta.

remainingUncertainty: BHUMI visibly serves parcel map data, but a reusable, openly licensed parcel-list endpoint for Jakarta has not been found. The portal's authenticated internal API was not used as an open-data source.
nextStep: Revisit if ATR/BPN or Jakarta Satu publishes an open parcel-list endpoint or clear reuse terms.
